Name: Kenneth's All Vanilla Cooked Foods
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's All Vanilla Cooked Foods[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A small quality of life add-on for my main mod Kenneth's Restaurant.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds all vanilla cooked foods directly to Kenneth's Restaurant, so you can buy them anytime without needing to cook.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]From Fried Egg to Moss Soup, every vanilla cooked dish is included. Infinite stock, always available.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Includes all vanilla cooked foods, including Ginger Island recipes[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Sold at Kenneth's Restaurant[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Infinite stock[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Configurable shop location via Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]By default, all foods are sold at Shop5. You can change this in the config if you want them in a different shop.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Just visit Kenneth's Restaurant and open the shop you set. Everything will be there.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Restaurant main mod[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu optional, for changing shop location easily[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with existing saves, no need for a new save[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- No conflicts, only adds items to the shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Safe to add or remove anytime[/b][/size]
